title: Legacy Dialpad Code Generator
description: On a vintage numeric keypad, each digit maps to a set of alphabetic characters (similar to standard phone keypads). Given a string containing digits from 2-9 inclusive, return all possible letter combinations that the number could represent. Return the answer in any order.
constraints: digits[i] is a digit in the range ['2', '9'].
output_format: A list of strings representing all possible letter combinations.

examples.explanation: Digit 2 maps to [a,b,c] and digit 3 maps to [d,e,f], creating 9 combinations.
An empty input returns an empty list.
A single digit maps directly to its corresponding characters.
